description: Ty23 (1'E) steam locomotive with its tender on td.scn, made from the works drawings in the Stacja Muzeum collection, AI driver on the td/rozklad timetable: starts from Stacja1, keeps to the speed limit, brakes to a stop at Przystanek. Needs the placeholder vehicle pkp/ty23_v1, not in the SVN yet. The stop may come up to 100 m past the mark: the Ty23 brakes with what its drawing 22.01a gives, two 14" cylinders at 3.5 at through a lever ratio of 5.75, 39.9 t on the shoes, 47 % of its weight on the coupled axles, in G only, and the AI starts braking for it late (60 m past in the run of 2026-11-25).
